forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {演|えん}じていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to perform, to play (a role), to act
definitions.explanation: To portray a character on stage, in film, or in other performances. Also used figuratively for playing a role or part in real life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{演|えん}じた。
⟦{悪役|あくやく}→悪役：12675_akuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{演|えん}じる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said that playing the villain is difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{演|えん}じて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He plays an important role within the team.

notes:
USAGE:
Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the role being performed: ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{演|えん}じる (to play a role). The figurative usage (⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{演|えん}じる — to play a role/part in something) is also very common.

Related to the noun ⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧ (acting, performance). An older variant form is {演|えん}ずる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{演|えん}じる: to play a role
- ⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{演|えん}じる: to play the lead
- ⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{演|えん}じる: to play a part (figurative)
- ⟦{悪役|あくやく}→悪役：12675_akuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{演|えん}じる: to play the villain
